trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. The platinum pops the moment the last one lands — no multiplayer or DLC needed, and the whole list is single-player.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum pops automatically once the last one lands.
No multiplayer or DLC is needed — the whole list is single-player.
Budget around 200 hours; most of it is the 100% checklist for A Long Road.
Keep cheats off the whole run: they disable trophies and saving.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It unlocks automatically and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1.
It unlocks automatically after the first main mission.
It cannot be missed — just start the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. It pops once you start Chapter 2.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 1.
It pops once you play the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. It is awarded as Chapter 3 begins.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 2.
It is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It arrives once Chapter 4 is under way.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 3.
It arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. It pops after the chapter's final mission.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 4.
It pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Free roam carries on after the credits, so the cleanup continues.

steps.text: Finish the last mission of the story.
Free roam carries on after the credits, so you can clean up everything else afterwards.
There is no mission replay, but no trophy depends on how you play a mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 story mission. It unlocks during the mission.

steps.text: Play Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 story mission.
The trophy unlocks during the mission.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission.

steps.text: Play The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission.
The trophy unlocks during the mission.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play, a Chapter 4 story mission.

steps.text: Play Child's Play, a Chapter 4 story mission.
The trophy unlocks during the mission.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, a Chapter 4 story mission.

steps.text: Play Headliners, a Chapter 4 story mission.
The trophy unlocks during the mission.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 story mission.

steps.text: Play VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 story mission.
The trophy unlocks during the mission.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 story mission.

steps.text: Play Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 story mission.
The trophy unlocks during the mission.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The checklist opens after the story, but everything you did before already counts — and it asks for far less than true 100%.

steps.text: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Everything you did before already counts, and nothing on it is missable.
It is closer to 60% true completion: most side quests and collectibles are only partly required.
Required in full: all robberies (8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations), underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold, all drone races, Bret's 15 Target Decks.
Only a share of the rest: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans.
Each meditation counts +2 if you do it with both Jason and Lucia.

trophies.disagreement: Sources disagree on time: PowerPyx, GTABase and most guides say about 200 hours; Push Square says 300 hours or more. Both are launch-week estimates, not measured averages.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest way to pile them up.

steps.text: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts, in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
Flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack them up, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed.
Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and show every Stunt Spot on the map.
The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Most come naturally from the story.

steps.text: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race, and a stunt.
Check what is left under Touchpad > Progress > Activities.
Most come naturally from the story; filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find the rest.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 ranges.

steps.text: Get a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds across 12 ranges.
The gold medals are not too difficult; work through the ranges as they appear.
Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for the trophy.

steps.text: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; one win per location is enough here.
The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finish each location while you are there.
Drone races are required in full for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeating the same race does not count.

steps.text: Win 20 different races; there are 40 to choose from.
Winning the same race again does not count — vary the events.
A race win also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. He marks the spot himself once you meet him.

steps.text: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon.
Play through his fishing quests.
Beat him in his challenge to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Three are on the TV at home; the fourth is on cabinets around Leonida.

steps.text: Reach the end of any one arcade game.
Three games (Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind) are on the TV at home; the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida.
An arcade game also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. His five quests are Lucia-only and run in order.

steps.text: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville.
Do all five in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass.
The last one, Puff Puff Pass, awards the trophy — and the quests are still there after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. He wants treasure from 7 shipwrecks — dive for it, then come back later when he texts again.

steps.text: Kenton (green KR icon in Key Lento) hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks.
Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig it up.
He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so you can finish it then.
Track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub.

steps.text: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
The fifth, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy.
They stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying mission strands for strangers. Not every stranger counts — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not.

steps.text: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count.
The quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy.
The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed — check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list.
None of them are needed for 100%, and all stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His vehicle deliveries also count toward the 100 optional missions.

steps.text: Play through Randy's quest line to its final mission.
Randy's vehicle deliveries count toward the 100 optional missions for the 100% checklist.
Character quest lines stay available after the story in free roam.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. His line does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

steps.text: Play through Tyrone's quest line to its final mission.
Tyrone's line does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
Character quest lines stay available after the story in free roam.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation first — it is the one that can be missed.

steps.text: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, with Jason and Lucia.

Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation first: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, then goes to the balcony. Follow her and choose Accept.
This is the one possibly missable trophy: the Chapter 1 meditation disappears after that chapter, and there is no mission replay.
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter (15 manual slots) so you can go back.
Each meditation counts +2 toward 100% if you do it with both Jason and Lucia.

trophies.disagreement: Sources disagree: PowerPyx says the Chapter 1 balcony meditation adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, so it is unclear whether it counts toward the 18; GTABase and OutputLag treat it as the missable one. Do it anyway.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His Target Decks are part of the 100% checklist, so the hunt and the checklist advance together.

steps.text: Take Bret's hunt and bring down the unique animal he marks.
Bret's 15 Target Decks are required in full for 100% completion.
Study animals with binoculars as you go — 100 of 255 count toward 100%.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full sets of collectible cards. There are 18 sets in the game, and you only need 15 of them for 100%.

steps.text: Complete 3 full sets of collectible cards.
There are 18 sets in the game; only 15 of them are needed for 100% completion, so you can skip three sets.
Collect cards as you explore; a set completes when every card in it is found.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The same 100 scans count toward 100% completion.

steps.text: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app.
The 100% checklist also wants 100 WAiNK scans, so this trophy and 100% advance together.
Scan vehicles too: 200 of 277 base models count toward 100%.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. For 100% you need 70, so you can skip the hardest 10.

steps.text: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges.
For 100% you need 70 of 80, so you can skip the hardest 10.
Challenges unlock as you play; check them under Progress.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Your partner has to be with you when the heat drops.

steps.text: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape.
Several trophies need Jason and Lucia together, so most open up once both are playable in Chapter 2.
Your partner must be with you when the wanted level drops — play it in a story moment with both of them.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level.

steps.text: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole time.
Do it with Jason and Lucia together (Chapter 2 onward).
Shop robberies are part of the robbery set the 100% checklist requires in full.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan them with WAiNK as you go — 200 of 277 base models count toward 100%.

steps.text: Discover 100 different vehicles as you explore Leonida.
Scan any new vehicle you come across with the WAiNK app by holding Up then R1 (unlocked in Chapter 1).
For 100% completion you need to scan any 200 of the 277 base model vehicles — also scan boats and aircraft.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Train Focus at the shooting ranges first.

steps.text: Down 5 enemies during one activation of Combat Focus.
Train Focus at shooting ranges first — the 42 golds for The Shootist raise it.
The trophy pops the moment the fifth enemy drops inside one activation.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. PowerPyx shows a worked method; no second source has confirmed the exact trigger yet.

steps.text: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport.
PowerPyx shows a worked method with screenshots.
Follow its walkthrough, but note no second source has confirmed the exact trigger yet.

trophies.disagreement: Sources disagree: U7BUY gives only the bare description (an unauthorized departure from VCIA); PowerPyx shows a worked method. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by a second source.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Take control of a Rhino military tank and meet the hidden combat requirement. PowerPyx shows a worked method; the exact combat requirement is not pinned down by a second source.

steps.text: Take control of a Rhino military tank and meet the hidden combat requirement.
PowerPyx shows a worked method with screenshots.
Follow its walkthrough, but note no second source has confirmed the exact combat requirement yet.

trophies.disagreement: Sources disagree on the exact trigger: U7BUY says take a Rhino and meet a hidden combat requirement; PowerPyx shows a worked method. Treat the precise condition as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the approach and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

steps.text: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
Plan the approach and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
Jewelry store robberies are part of the robbery set the 100% checklist requires in full.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The 100% checklist requires all 8, so keep robbing past 5.

steps.text: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape.
Marked bills come from Payday Loans, small banks and large bank vaults; a large vault pays up to $205,000.
The 100% checklist requires all 8 bank vaults, so keep robbing past 5.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape.

steps.text: Rob an armored truck and get away.
Armored truck robberies are part of the robbery set the 100% checklist requires in full.
Robberies unlock in Chapters 3 and 4.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The story and side content cover most of them naturally.

steps.text: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida.
The map unfogs as you explore; the story and side content cover most areas naturally.
52 areas is the count PSN tracks for this trophy.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation from each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, and 100% wants all of them.

steps.text: Rob one Illegal Operation from each of the 9 gangs; there are 39 operations in total.
The Progress menu lists all nine groups, so you can see which gang still has zero completed operations.
Group gangs by region to cover the map in a few long drives instead of zigzagging across Leonida.
The 100% checklist requires all 39 operations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The method is shown by one source only — treat it as provisional.

steps.text: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
PowerPyx shows a worked method with screenshots.
OutputLag lists it among five hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger — treat the method as provisional until a second source confirms it.

trophies.disagreement: Unconfirmed vs method: OutputLag lists this as one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger; PowerPyx shows a worked method. Treat as unconfirmed until two sources agree.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The method is shown by one source only — treat it as provisional.

steps.text: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
PowerPyx shows a worked method with screenshots.
OutputLag lists it among five hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger — treat the method as provisional until a second source confirms it.

trophies.disagreement: Unconfirmed vs method: OutputLag lists this as one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger; PowerPyx shows a worked method. Treat as unconfirmed until two sources agree.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Complete the hidden objective at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.

steps.text: Complete the hidden objective at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowling is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
The objective is hidden until you complete it — just play a full game at the alley.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. One source says it is about maxing both characters' Strength; no other guide confirms a method.

steps.text: U7BUY says: raise both Jason's and Lucia's Strength attributes to maximum.
If that reading is right, both characters must be maxed — play as each and train between missions.
No other guide we read confirms a method, so treat this as unconfirmed.

trophies.disagreement: Sources disagree: U7BUY says max both characters' Strength attributes; no other guide we read confirms a method. Treat as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Avoid the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent.

steps.text: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile.
Your Criminal Profile only affects how police treat you; the lower it is, the more likely they shoot on sight.
Avoid the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent, and cops will be more aggressive.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The exact method is unverified — do not trust any single posted method yet.

steps.text: Trigger a hidden second-chance event; the exact method remains unverified.
OutputLag lists it as one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger.
Do not trust any single posted method yet — wait for two sources to agree.

trophies.disagreement: Unconfirmed: OutputLag and U7BUY both say the exact method is unverified. Do not trust any single method posted yet.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A mysterious hidden encounter whose exact trigger is unverified.

steps.text: Experience a mysterious hidden encounter; the exact trigger remains unverified.
OutputLag lists it as one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger.
Do not trust any single posted method yet — wait for two sources to agree.

trophies.disagreement: Unconfirmed: OutputLag and U7BUY both say the exact method is unverified. Do not trust any single method posted yet.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The precise conditions remain under investigation.

steps.text: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by.
OutputLag lists it as one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger.
The precise conditions remain under investigation — treat any posted method as unverified.

trophies.disagreement: Unconfirmed: the precise conditions remain under investigation. Treat any posted method as unverified.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Get the Dye Pack Jammer first, then hit the big vaults.

steps.text: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts.
Before any fence accepts marked bills, get the Dye Pack Jammer from the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew).
Marked bills come from Payday Loans, small banks and large bank vaults; a large vault pays up to $205,000.
The same $250,000 counts toward 100% completion.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Everyday purchases add up while you play normally.

steps.text: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops.
Money comes fastest from robberies and fencing; the Dye Pack Jammer (Chapter 3, Credit Check) unlocks marked-bill fencing.
Spending counts across all shops — everyday purchases add up while you play normally.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy each one as it becomes available; the eighth purchase pops the trophy.

steps.text: Buy all 8 purchasable garage properties.
Buy each garage property as it becomes available; the eighth purchase pops the trophy.
Properties are bought with cash earned across the run — robberies, fencing and missions all pay.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Vehicles you discover for Whip It Good are the ones to register.

steps.text: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app.
Registration is done through the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone.
Discover vehicles as you explore — 100 discoveries count toward Whip It Good.
